disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; clinically diagnosed with autism according to DSM-IV, DSM-5, or ICD-10 criteria (LEAP) or site-specific procedures using ADOS and/or ADI-R (ABIDE). Normative model trained on neurotypical controls and applied to autistic individuals.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The final sample included 796 autistic individuals (141 females; age-range: 5-58) and 1028 neuro-typical (NT) individuals (256 females; age-range: 5-56) recruited across 32 different sites."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three datasets pooled: EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP), Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange I (ABIDE-I), and Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange II (ABIDE-II).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We pooled scans from three large datasets: the EU-AIMS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) ... and the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchanges I and II, or ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II"

age.detail: Age range 5–58 from text; mean and SD from Table 1 ALL column for the autistic group (16.2 ± 7.0). Values represent the pooled autistic sample across LEAP, ABIDE-I, and ABIDE-II.
age.supporting_text: "796 autistic individuals (141 females; age-range: 5-58)"; Table 1 ALL column: Age (mean ± SD) = 16.2 ±7.0
